feedback: The current geometry with 5 sensors at 0.016 m sensor size and 0.16 m wheel track improved coverage and stability but still shows persistent line loss events and no finishes on the slalom track (iteration 1 data). Adding two more sensors to create a 7-sensor symmetric array should improve lateral line coverage and reduce line loss events, especially in sharp curves. If the next race shows reduced line loss events and lower rms_error, continue refining sensor positions and possibly increase sensor size if coverage remains insufficient. If steering oscillation remains high, consider slightly increasing wheel track or tuning PID gains to reduce oscillations. If progress or completion rates remain low, consider reducing mass further or increasing base_speed to improve acceleration and finish rates. These suggestions are based on iteration 1 evidence showing benefits of larger sensors and wider wheel track but persistent challenges on complex tracks.
requested_changes: sensor_positions expanded to 7 sensors symmetrically spaced to improve lateral coverage, based on iteration 1 showing persistent line loss events
maintain sensor_size at 0.016 m to preserve coverage and noise tolerance, supported by iteration 1 improvements
